title: SimulateUserActivity doesn't unlock the screen, even when unlocking without password is enabled
line: Calling SimulateUserActivity, as game controller tools do, now dismisses the lock screen while it can still be unlocked without a password, like moving the mouse does.
explanation: The org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver SimulateUserActivity D-Bus method only reset KIdleTime's idle timers. Real input reaches KSldApp::userActivity() through KWin, which unlocks when the lock is still in its 'unlock without password' grace period, but the D-Bus method never called it, so tools like joystickwake could not wake the screen. The method now also calls KSldApp::userActivity(), so it behaves like real input: it unlocks only during the grace time or when no password is required.

commits.message:
interface: let SimulateUserActivity unlock during the grace period

SimulateUserActivity only reset the idle timers, so unlike real input it
never dismissed a lock in its grace period. Now it also counts as user
activity, which unlocks only in the grace time or without a password.

BUG: 439312

Subject: [PATCH] interface: let SimulateUserActivity unlock during the grace
 period

SimulateUserActivity only reset the idle timers, so unlike real input it

activity, which unlocks only in the grace time or without a password.

---
 interface.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/interface.cpp b/interface.cpp
index 0660456f..4e26ea66 100644
--- a/interface.cpp
+++ b/interface.cpp
@@ -189,6 +189,7 @@ void Interface::serviceUnregistered(const QString &name)
 void Interface::SimulateUserActivity()
 {
     KIdleTime::instance()->simulateUserActivity();
+    m_daemon->userActivity();
 }
 
 uint Interface::Throttle(const QString &application_name, const QString &reason_for_inhibit)

media.caption: Master: idle lock with a 300 s grace period, 3 s after calling SimulateUserActivity. Still locked (GetActive true).
With the fix: same steps, the lock is dismissed and the desktop is back (GetActive false).

review.text: Calling m_daemon->userActivity() in Interface::SimulateUserActivity() makes simulated user activity behave consistently with real input by dismissing an idle lock only while inside the configured passwordless grace period. Verification confirms it unlocks during the grace window and never bypasses password protection when LockGrace is 0, with all kscreenlocker autotests passing.

reviews.text: Calling m_daemon->userActivity() in Interface::SimulateUserActivity() makes simulated user activity behave consistently with real input by dismissing an idle lock only while inside the configured passwordless grace period. Verification confirms it unlocks during the grace window and never bypasses password protection when LockGrace is 0, with all kscreenlocker autotests passing.

One-line change in Interface::SimulateUserActivity that also calls KSldApp::userActivity(), the same path KWin uses for real input, which only unlocks when isGraceTime() or !m_requirePassword. That fixes what the title describes without bypassing the password outside grace (verified with LockGrace=0), and the before/after shots plus the GetActive results back it up. The commit message, line and explanation match the patch. It is minimal and in the right repo, so I'd expect a maintainer to accept it given the controller use case in c2.
